blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine women’s swimming team, bannered by Kayla Sanchez, Heather White, Xiandi Chua and Teia Salvino, was disqualified in the Asian Games 2026 4×100-meter freestyle relay final on Sunday at Tokyo Aquatics Center. Sanchez gave her team a strong start, just a few seconds behind eventual winner China, only for the Philippines to lose momentum. White moved the team to third with the podium still within reach, but during Chua’s turn, the Philippines dropped to fifth.
